title: Mihakk engine event
description: One line of the NDJSON stream the Go engine serves at GET /v1/runs/{id}/events. Every event carries a monotonic seq so the orchestrator can resume with ?from_seq=N after a disconnect and detect gaps.

seq.description: Monotonic, gap-free per run. A gap means events were lost.

requests_used.description: Units of the request budget spent. Every attempt is charged, including one the safety layer then refused at the address check, so this is NOT a count of requests that reached a target: use http_answered for requests a response was observed to, and executed + baseline_attempted for cases attempted.

executed.description: Cases that passed the safety layer and were attempted. This is not a claim that the target received anything; a refused connection is still an attempt.

refused.description: Cases that ended in a local or safety refusal. A redirected case can have earlier answered HTTP hops; consult http_* before saying nothing was attempted. Reported as refusals happen.

attempted.description: Cases with at least one actual HTTP attempt. It can overlap refused when an earlier redirect hop was attempted before a later hop was locally refused.

answered.description: Cases that completed with a final response. attempted counts cases with any actual HTTP attempt; http_answered counts every response, including intermediate redirect hops.

baseline_attempted.description: Baseline requests the safety layer let through. An attempt, not a delivery: a refused connection is an attempt.

baseline_refused.description: Baseline requests the safety layer refused; nothing was sent.

baseline_answered.description: Baseline requests that completed with a final response. Intermediate redirect responses are counted in http_answered.

http_answered.description: HTTP requests -- one per redirect hop -- that received a response. The unit the budget is charged in; never to be presented as a case count.

http_unanswered.description: HTTP requests attempted with no response: a refused connection, a reset, a timeout.

http_refused.description: HTTP requests charged to the budget and refused at connect by the address check.

events_dropped.description: Emitted when the run's ring buffer overflows. The engine reports the loss explicitly rather than letting events vanish silently; the orchestrator must mark the session incomplete.

total_seq.description: The final seq the engine emitted. The orchestrator compares this against what it received to decide completeness.
